title: Lottery spending as income share
hook: Two stated cases: explore the income denominator with fixed spending.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the income denominator with fixed spending affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Percent, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the income denominator with fixed spending in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
